business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Internet - DTC Brand Webstore

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: common-law-based statutory corporate framework modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law, combined with constitutional law provisions and customary land/authority statutes
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States, Title II economic relations provisions
No standalone Marshall Islands bilateral investment treaty has been ratified as of the effective date

No comprehensive double tax avoidance agreement is currently in force in respect of the Marshall Islands; the DTC e-commerce entity relies on domestic tax-exempt status and neutral cross-border levy treatment

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Marshall Islands Revised Code Title 31, Chapter 1, Business Corporations Act (31 MIRC Ch. 1), as amended by the Business Corporation Beneficial Ownership Amendment Act and registered-agent implementing regulations; the Registered Agents Act 2013; the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit AML/CFT Directives; and applicable provisions of Title 32 MIRC regarding money laundering and transnational organized crime

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Executed Articles of Incorporation and registered agent acceptance form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporator / notary public in the jurisdiction of execution; countersigned by the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing jurisdiction is a Hague Apostille Convention Contracting State; otherwise consular legalization by the Marshall Islands honorary consulate or diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy and professional identity record for each proposed director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or certified AML/KYC professional in the document holder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, depending on the country of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address and source of funds evidence for each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issued by a bank, utility company, audit firm, or notary public in the beneficial owner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization where a foreign public document is required by the registered agent's AML policy

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory positive-match Politically Exposed Persons screening is required for all proposed directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, and authorized signatories. The screening protocol must check the OFAC SDN List, United Nations consolidated sanctions list, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, and any applicable domestic Marshall Islands designations. The registered agent must document the screening result, preserve the evidence for at least five years after termination of the business relationship, and promptly escalate any positive or ambiguous match to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit and the Registered Agent Compliance Officer.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry administered by the Office of the Attorney General; name clearance is effected exclusively through licensed registered agents using the RMI registered agent online transaction portal and is not available as a direct public self-service portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate registry operates in English using the Latin script. Proposed names in non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into a phonetically distinguishable English rendering and may be accepted with an English translation in parentheses. The name must include a statutory corporate suffix such as Corporation, Incorporated, Company, or Limited, and must be distinguishable from all reserved and registered names in the registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the registry rejects a proposed name, the licensed registered agent must file an administrative reconsideration request through the RMI registered agent portal within 14 days, identifying the distinguishing elements, the intended statutory corporate suffix, and, where applicable, a narrowed sensitive-token wording. If reconsideration is denied, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal to the Registrar within 30 days of the denial containing the full name request, the registry reference number, and the grounds of distinctiveness. The Registrar issues a final written decision within fifteen business days. Alternatively, the applicant may submit a new name reservation with an additional name search fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only to the extent that the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent maintains the statutory physical registered office, receives legal and regulatory service of process, and retains the corporate record book. A virtual correspondence or reception address may be used for administrative mail and customer-service routing, but it cannot replace the registered agent and registered office required under 31 MIRC Ch. 1. For a non-resident DTC e-commerce business, no physical local business premises, employee presence, or stock location is required in the Marshall Islands.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. For a non-resident, tax-exempt Business Corporation engaged exclusively in internet retail and DTC e-commerce with a fully compliant registered agent and no physical operations in the Marshall Islands, the estimated probability of an unannounced on-site inspection is below 5%. The registered agent itself remains subject to periodic compliance inspections by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit and the Registrar.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and exclusive 30-day name reservation fee for one proposed Business Corporation name
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent remitting the applicable registry fee to the RMI Corporate Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark plus statutory name reservation tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee for a standard non-resident Business Corporation with minimal authorized capital
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry through the licensed registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under 31 MIRC Ch. 1; final amount depends on authorized share capital and expedite election

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year licensed registered agent and statutory registered office service fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a non-resident exempt Business Corporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership capture, UBO register preparation, AML/KYC due diligence, and PEP/sanctions screening file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent AML compliance officer and privacy/data protection function
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a Low_Risk_Standard DTC e-commerce retail entity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, translation, apostille, and consular legalization of the incorporation and identity document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent apostille authority in the client's country; honorary consul of the Republic of the Marshall Islands where consular legalization is required
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Country-specific notarial tariffs, apostille schedules, and RMI consular service fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Optional expedited incorporation processing fee for 24-48 hour corporate birth certificate issuance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent fast-track service desk
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Optional market service charge, not a government statutory fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (B.C.A., modelled on the Delaware General Corporation Law; codified under the Marshall Islands Revised Code), applicable sections 29 (Articles of Incorporation; contents and execution), 33 (registered office and registered agent), 39 (annual report and franchise tax) and the Registrar's published fee schedule.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Business Registry Division, Ministry of Finance of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro Atoll; filings are presented directly or through a duly licensed Marshall Islands registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Section 29 B.C.A.), together with the registered agent's consent; the Registrar issues the official Certificate of Incorporation evidencing the creation of the legal entity.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement: the Corporation may register with authorized capital of 5,000 shares without par value, and subscriber consideration may consist of cash, services, or property. Capital is fully paid and nonassessable upon the board's declaration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Bylaws be adopted as the rules of internal management. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the Corporation allot the shares subscribed under the Subscription Agreement as fully paid and nonassessable consideration reflected in the corporate books. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the registered office be fixed at the registered agent's address in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the agent is authorized to receive service of process. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the following officers are elected: President, Chief Financial Officer, and Secretary, each to serve until the next annual meeting and until successors are elected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name availability search and reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Business Registry Division, Ministry of Finance, Majuro (via a licensed registered agent).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name search against the Registrar's corporate name index and confirm the proposed name is distinguishable from all prior registrations; submit the name reservation request with the registered agent's endorsement, indicating a corporate suffix ('Corporation', 'Company', 'Incorporated', 'Limited' or abbreviation). Reserve the name for statutory priority.
required_dossiers: Copy of the proposed corporate name search report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as confusingly similar or impermissible, file an amended reservation with a revised primary and alternate name; re-run the availability search and resubmit within the next business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, execution, and notarization of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and licensed Marshall Islands registered agent; the executed instrument is delivered to the Registrar for review.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation under Section 29 B.C.A., stating: (i) the corporate name; (ii) the Majuro registered office address and the name of the licensed registered agent; (iii) the authorized share structure (e.g., 5,000 shares without par value); (iv) the initial directors; and (v) the incorporator's name and address. The incorporator executes the articles before a notary public or consular officer; the registered agent's written acceptance is attached.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Incorporation (original and copy)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On technical objection, obtain the Registrar's deficiency notice, execute a corrective amendment or restated articles, and refile with the correction fee; clearance is generally granted within one to two business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing, fee payment, and issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (original documents and fee remittance).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the executed Articles of Incorporation with the USD 275 filing fee (standard authorized capital up to 5,000 shares) via wire transfer or cashier's check in the name of the Registrar, or through the licensed agent's escrow. Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation; the agent then releases the charter packet for bank onboarding and marketplace compliance.
required_dossiers: Cover letter from the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration is queried for defective notarization, corporate name, or fee shortfall, cure the stated deficiency and resubmit with the outstanding fee; expedited processing is available on request where urgent issuance is needed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirmation of registered office and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent in Majuro and the Office of the Registrar of Corporations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify that the registered office is maintained in the Republic of the Marshall Islands at the registered agent's physical business address, and that the agent is licensed to act under Section 33 B.C.A. File the agent's formal acceptance with the Registrar and keep the statutory register of the agent's identity current.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar disallows the designated agent, engage a substitute licensed agent and file the change-of-agent notice so that a registered office and agent remain continuously maintained.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Bylaws and organizational governance (First Board Resolutions)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and first directors of the Corporation (private organizational meeting by unanimous written consent).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting: adopt the Bylaws; approve the First Board Resolution allotting subscribed shares, fixing the registered office, and appointing the President, Chief Financial Officer, and Secretary; approve the banking resolutions and authorize the merchant account applications for Shopify Payments, PayPal, and Stripe; and certify the corporate minute book.
required_dossiers: Share subscription agreement and register of shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any procedural omission is cured by a ratifying unanimous written consent executed by all directors, retroactively validating the organizational actions and attaching the missing acceptances to the minute book.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Annual registration, franchise tax enrollment, and compliance handover
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations and the licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enroll the Corporation in the Registrar's annual reporting cycle: the annual report/franchise tax (USD 275 for up to 5,000 shares, due in the anniversary month) must be paid before the due date. Direct the registered agent to maintain the statutory registers, good-standing filings, and banking documentation, and confirm that no domestic business license is triggered for the offshore webstore.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For a late annual filing or deficiency notice, cure by paying the prescribed late penalty and interest with the annual report and, if the entity was administratively dissolved, file a reinstatement petition with all arrears settled.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable: the statutory business licensing regime of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Business License Act, Ministry of Finance; Foreign Investment Business License Act for foreign-controlled entities) applies only where a business is carried on within the territorial jurisdiction. The Shopify DTC webstore conducts all sales, logistics, and payment processing abroad and therefore triggers no domestic business license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for the non-resident webstore. If the Corporation later establishes a physical office, warehouse, or retail presence in the Marshall Islands, it must obtain a national Business License and, for foreign-controlled operations, a Foreign Investment Business License before commencing domestic activities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, established under the Environmental Protection Act 1984.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / No EIA required: the DTC e-commerce operation is a virtual storefront with no fixed capital project, land disturbance, construction, or material emission in the Marshall Islands, so no EIA registration, environmental review, or environmental permit is triggered under the EPA Act.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable on the current facts. If an RMI-based warehouse is opened, all e-commerce packaging waste must be handled by an EPA-licensed waste contractor; wastewater discharge must meet EPA trade-waste effluent standards; no uncontrolled VOC emissions or leachate-bearing stormwater may be released from the facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable: the webstore has no physical premises, employees, or stored inventory within the Republic, so no fire safety certification, structural load inspection, or workplace clearance is required. If the Corporation opens an office or warehouse in Majuro, it must obtain a fire code certificate from the Majuro emergency/fire authority, a structural completion inspection from the relevant buildings and land-use authority, and workplace health-and-safety clearance under domestic labor law before occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Office (RTO), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; official correspondence via email and physical filing to the RTO, with no fully automated national tax filing portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-Resident Business Corporations are exempt from Marshall Islands income tax and are not statutorily required to obtain a TIN. If a TIN is desired for banking, customs brokerage, or contracting counterparty verification, the foreign entity (through its registered agent) must submit to the RTO a TIN application form together with a certified copy of the Articles of Incorporation, the Non-Resident Corporation certificate, and evidence of the registered agent appointment. The RTO issues a TIN without creating any tax filing obligation or domestic tax nexus.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, a foreign-owned corporation may elect to operate as a Non-Resident Business Corporation by expressly stating its non-resident status in the Articles of Incorporation and by refraining from carrying on business within the Marshall Islands. This election is recorded with the Registrar of Corporations and confers a comprehensive exemption from Marshall Islands income tax, gross revenue tax, franchise tax, and all other territorial taxes. The jurisdiction does not provide a check-the-box classification regime similar to the United States, and hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized under Marshall Islands tax law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST or general sales tax; the Marshall Islands imposes a Gross Revenue Tax on businesses engaged in domestic business activity, but non-resident exempt corporations are outside its scope.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable for VAT/GST because no such tax exists. For the limited Gross Revenue Tax, any person engaged in business within the Marshall Islands must register with the RTO irrespective of turnover; no threshold applies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API-based reporting, or digital stamping requirement exists in the Marshall Islands. The RTO does not operate an e-invoicing or clearance platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — the Marshall Islands levies no VAT, GST, or sales tax, and therefore contains no zero-rating mechanism for exports. Export of goods or services by a non-resident Business Corporation is tax-exempt and outside the scope of domestic gross revenue tax; no refund procedure is necessary.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating clawback regime exists. If a non-resident corporation is found to have engaged in domestic business within the Marshall Islands without proper registration, the RTO may assess Gross Revenue Tax, interest, and penalties. Knowingly submitting false statements to the RTO or Customs may attract monetary fines and, in egregious cases, criminal sanctions. There is no statutory export-credit VAT clawback mechanism.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: None - the Republic of the Marshall Islands does not maintain a central bank; the U.S. dollar is legal tender, monetary policy is set by the U.S. Federal Reserve, and the Marshall Islands Commissioner of Banking and Ministry of Finance supervise licensed financial institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Because the U.S. dollar is the sole circulating and legal currency, there is no domestic currency to convert. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are fully open and are not subject to exchange-control approval. Profit remittance, dividend payments, and capital repatriation may proceed without central-bank consent or FX licensing. The only practical hurdles are bank-level AML/KYC documentary safeguards, board resolutions, and source-of-funds verification required by correspondent banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender rule, mandatory repatriation timeline, or compulsory conversion ratio in the Marshall Islands. Export proceeds may remain in U.S. dollars in any licensed domestic bank account or in offshore accounts of the business corporation. No RMI Government exchange-control filing is required.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam - Marshall Islands Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account / E-Commerce Collection Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-Medium as a primary treasury rail. Offshore digital payment institutions such as Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, and Stripe Treasury are commercially available to an RMI non-resident Business Corporation and may be used for customer collections or supplier disbursements, but they do not constitute RMI banking licenses. RMI AML/CFT law treats unauthorized deposit-taking as restricted; therefore a licensed domestic settlement bank remains necessary for capital injection, statutory records, and corporate treasury integrity. Foreign EMIs must be fully licensed in their home jurisdiction, must comply with U.S. OFAC and UN sanctions screening, and cannot offer a domestic RMI bank account or clear USD through the domestic banking system.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Bank of Marshall Islands generally requires the presence of the directors and authorized signatories for an in-person KYC interview at its Majuro branch during initial onboarding. Fully remote account opening is not ordinarily permitted for non-resident offshore Business Corporations. Bank of Guam may accept notarized certificates and video-call interviews under enhanced due diligence, but physical presence can still be required for higher-risk, tax-exempt, non-resident entities. Each bank also requires at least one authorized signatory with valid identity documents and a certified record of the board resolution approving the account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident offshore Business Corporation structured as an RMI entity with no physical operational substance or national tax filing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Articles of Incorporation or Charter; certificate of good standing from the RMI Registrar; registered agent and registered office certificate; current director and shareholder register; beneficial ownership declaration; board resolution for account opening; annual license fee receipt; evidence of management substance, including premises arrangement, director meeting minutes, and corporate records kept in Majuro where Economic Substance Regulations apply.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large lump-sum U.S. dollar capital injection from a shareholder whose source of wealth is opaque.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Subscription agreement or share purchase contract; shareholder source-of-wealth questionnaire; prior bank statements and asset-origin trail; audited or internally reviewed financial statements of the shareholder; certified ownership chain; CPA reference letter; and an explanation of the funds flowing through one or more intermediary accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume Shopify, PayPal, and Stripe settlement traffic with many counterparties, small transactions, and cross-border customer payments that resemble a pass-through or money-laundering pattern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant account agreement and platform onboarding records; monthly settlement reports from Shopify Payments, PayPal, and Stripe; website and product-catalog evidence; order-level transaction history for larger vouchers; customer and shipping records; supplier purchase contracts and commercial invoices; inventory/logistics documentation; chargeback records; and OFAC or UN sanctions screening output for transactions above the bank's internal threshold.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt or 'zero-tax' jurisdiction classification as a high-risk indicator under correspondent-bank or U.S. correspondent-Aml standards.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI taxation status memorandum confirming the limited scope of non-resident Business Corporation tax exposure; payment proof of all statutory franchise or annual fees; confirmation of non-residence in the business-license and tax sense; a permanent-establishment analysis showing that e-commerce websites and platform sales do not create a taxable or PE presence in RMI; and board minutes documenting the bona fide commercial purpose of the treasury arrangements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For an RMI non-resident Business Corporation, the recommended rail is a U.S. dollar transfer from the shareholder's or ultimate beneficial owner's bank to the RMI bank's USD correspondent account via SWIFT MT103 or U.S. Fedwire/CHIPS. RMI law imposes no foreign-exchange approval obligation and no statutory purpose-code regime. The bank will, however, require accurate remittance information in field 70, including the words 'Equity Capital Contribution' or 'Foreign Direct Investment', the borrower or issuer reference, the Corporate ID or account number, and a cross-reference to the subscription agreement and board resolution. The full source-of-wealth and corporate KYC dossier must accompany the first injection, and the same correspondent bank will conduct OFAC, UN, and interdict screening. Upon completion of the screening and compliance sign-off, funds are released to the Capital Escrow Account, then re-classified to the Operational Account after the share issuance is recorded.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for inventory, logistics, and supplier payments should use SWIFT MT103 for single supplier invoices, MT202 for bank-to-bank transfers, MT700 for confirmed commercial letters of credit, or U.S. Fedwire for same-day USD settlement. Commercial letters of credit are appropriate for high-value goods with shipping documentation, using required documents such as invoice, packing list, bill of lading or airway bill, certificate of origin, and any inspection certificate. The RMI bank will rely on New York or Los Angeles correspondent/US clearing intermediaries; therefore payment finality is governed by U.S. clearing house rules. Where the beneficiary is located in a jurisdiction with currency controls, the USD rail remains valid and settlement is in USD without RMI FX conversion. All disbursements must reference the underlying commercial invoice and be supported by the transaction dossier to avoid a trade-pass-through AML trigger.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/USD treasury instruments are not required because the RMI has no domestic currency and the operating currency is USD.
Offshore deliverable foreign-exchange forwards for EUR, GBP, and AUD expense exposures, contracted through a foreign licensed bank with the RMI corporation as principal.
Cross-currency swaps and participating FX swaps for multi-year non-USD procurement contracts, executed outside RMI jurisdiction under common-law contract capacity.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for volatile customer-facing currencies such as IDR, INR, and PHP, settled in USD, provided the counterparty is a licensed offshore bank and the hedge is documented by board resolution.
Vanilla FX options on non-USD exposures, approved by the board and recorded in the corporate treasury register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (statutory corporate declaration of registered office, resident agent, directors/officers, and issued share capital)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); filed via licensed Resident Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before June 30 of each calendar year; first report due June 30 of the year following incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: USD 100 late-filing penalty after June 30; non-filing for two consecutive years permits administrative strike-off or dissolution by the Registrar after statutory notice

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (recurring license tax calculated on authorized share count)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (government treasury collection)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: June 30 of each year, payable together with the Annual Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly 10% surcharge on unpaid tax (subject to Registrar caps); two consecutive unpaid years permit administrative dissolution without court action

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for non-resident Business Corporations; the BCA imposes no mandatory audit or audit-threshold regime. Audit becomes mandatory only by shareholder resolution, court order, listing rules, or lender covenant.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: BCA Section 114 requires truthful books and records only; no prescribed format. Voluntary financial statements are typically prepared under IFRS or US GAAP; no filing with the Registrar is required.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public UBO filing in RMI; the licensed Resident Agent/Corporate Secretary performs an annual KYC refresh and a full audit of statutory registers. Each share transfer must be board-approved, recorded in the Register of Members, and reflected in the updated UBO/control-person attestation held at the registered office for Registrar inspection on demand.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Mortgages, Charges and Encumbrances

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not a legal requirement; voluntary review/audit engagement market range USD 5,000 - USD 15,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (the Republic of the Marshall Islands levies no general corporate income tax on non-resident Business Corporations; the RMI tax system is strictly territorial and an exempt BC's foreign-source income falls outside the tax base)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: De facto tax exemption under the Business Corporation Act: a non-resident Business Corporation is exempt from Marshall Islands income tax on foreign-source income provided it conducts no business in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, derives no income from RMI sources, maintains no local employees or property, and pays its annual registration and exemption fees. There is no payroll tax, capital gains tax, VAT, GST, or sales tax imposed at the corporate level. The only annual fiscal charge is the statutory registration and exemption fee paid through the RMI Registrar.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Marshall Islands income tax return (RMI Form T-1, issued under the Income Tax Act, Cap. 24) is the statutory return for any entity with RMI-source income. An exempt Business Corporation is not required to submit Form T-1; the operative annual filing is the BC annual report and exemption statement lodged through the registered agent with the Office of the RMI Registrar. No RMI electronic income-tax filing portal exists; paper filings are submitted via the registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual. The tax year is the calendar year (1 January to 31 December). The corporate annual exemption filing aligns with the anniversary of incorporation or the Registrar-designated renewal cycle.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For an exempt Business Corporation, no income tax return is due. The annual renewal and exemption statement must be filed no later than the anniversary date of incorporation each year. If RMI-source taxable income were unintentionally triggered, the income tax return is due within four months after the end of the tax year, i.e. by 30 April.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Corporate identity block (BC name, RMI registration number, registered agent, fiscal year end)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identifies the Business Corporation, its RMI registered agent, and its exemption certificate number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact registered company name and number. State 'Exempt Business Corporation' in the activity description and leave all income computation fields blank.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declares whether any gross income arose in, or was derived from, the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident Shopify DTC seller must select 'No'. Worldwide consumer e-commerce retail through Shopify Payments, PayPal and Stripe is foreign-source and non-taxable in the RMI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Invokes the foreign-source income exemption and confirms the absence of local trade, local property and local employees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert: 'BC elects the foreign-source income exemption under the Income Tax Act. E-commerce platforms, digital storefront, fulfilment centres, warehouses, servers and customers are located outside the Republic of the Marshall Islands.'

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual renewal and exemption statement incurs a Registrar late fee (typically USD 100 per month, subject to a cumulative cap), accelerated suspension of good standing, and reinstatement penalties up to USD 2,000. Continued non-filing leads to administrative strike-off. If an RMI-source return is wrongfully omitted, the Income Tax Act imposes a 5% monthly delinquency penalty on the tax due, capped at 50%, plus interest; wilful false certification is tax fraud and is prosecuted criminally.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (the Republic of the Marshall Islands does not impose dividend withholding tax or any other tax on distributions paid by a Business Corporation to its shareholders; outbound profit remittances from the Shopify DTC brand are free of RMI withholding tax)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double taxation agreement network currently applies to the Marshall Islands; therefore no treaty-relief application or Tax Residency Certificate is required to reduce or eliminate RMI withholding tax, because no RMI tax is imposed at source. If the shareholder's residence country seeks a tax residency certificate, the RMI Registrar can issue a certificate of corporate residency and good standing. The parent company should still comply with FATCA/CRS information exchange through the RMI competent authority and with market-jurisdiction withholding or digital services tax rules applicable to consumers.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rate for IP royalties and debt interest paid by an exempt RMI BC to non-residents: 0%. Treaty rates: not applicable due to the absence of a DTA network. Non-resident DSP/Shopify brand owners remain subject to source-country withholding taxes and VAT/digital services taxes in the markets where end consumers are located, but those are customer-borne commercial costs and do not constitute RMI withholding obligations.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable (USD): the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act does not adopt transfer-pricing documentation rules and does not impose mandatory Local File/Master File thresholds. As a defensive governance standard, management should maintain an internal pricing memorandum for intercompany transactions equal to or exceeding USD 10 million in consolidated turnover to substantiate arm's-length pricing before foreign tax authorities and CFC regimes.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Republic of the Marshall Islands does not apply EU/Caribbean-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) to ordinary non-resident Business Corporations. Nevertheless, foreign jurisdictions applying controlled-foreign-company, anti-havens or sham-transaction doctrines will expect genuine economic substance: a physical registered agent in Majuro, current board and accounting records, a transactional bank account, real e-commerce contracts, and evidence that commercial decisions are made outside the RMI. If the Shopify DTC brand operates as a pure mailbox shell, foreign tax authorities may recharacterize all profits, allocate income to the ultimate parent's jurisdiction, and impose domestic tax, penalties and interest retrospectively.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion and false foreign-source declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately mischaracterizing revenue with RMI domestic sources as foreign-source income on the exemption statement, or failing to disclose e-commerce fulfilment activity physically conducted in the Marshall Islands, such as warehousing, local logistics, or domestic retail into the RMI market.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Income Tax Act (Cap. 24) and the Criminal Code of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, tax fraud is a statutory offence punishable by a fine of up to USD 10,000, treble assessment of the evaded tax, statutory negligence and wilful penalties (50% late-payment penalty, 100% negligence penalty, 200% wilful penalty), and imprisonment of up to one year. The Registrar may also suspend, revoke or strike off the certificate of good standing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, registered agents and beneficial owners who sign or approve a false exemption declaration are subject to civil restitution for the evaded tax, personal assessment, travel bans, asset seizure, criminal prosecution and imprisonment where fraud is proven. The corporate veil is pierced because the fraudulent act is outside the legitimate corporate functions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company misuse and lack of economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the Shopify DTC brand as a pure mailbox entity with no real decision-making, no RMI substance beyond the registered office, no board records, no accounting records, and no separateness from the ultimate parent, while claiming tax-exempt status in the RMI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Business Corporation Act, failure to maintain a registered office, registered agent, annual accounts, and exemption records exposes the BC to monetary fines of up to USD 5,000, administrative strike-off, loss of limited liability, and judicial dissolution. Foreign tax authorities may reclassify the full DTC profit as attributable to the market jurisdiction and impose source-country income tax, VAT, penalties, and interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who authorize the continued operation of a defunct or sham corporation are jointly and severally liable for the company's debts, consumer refunds, and vendor claims. Civil restitution orders may reach personal assets of directors and shareholders where corporate formalities were abandoned or the entity was used as an instrument of fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the true beneficial owner of the Shopify payout accounts, failing to file the RMI beneficial-ownership declaration, using bearer-shares or nominee arrangements to obscure commercial control, or deliberately structuring PayPal/Stripe flows to bypass payment-provider identity checks and anti-money-laundering screening.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Act 2011, as amended, money laundering is punishable by a fine of up to USD 500,000 or imprisonment up to 20 years, or both, plus forfeiture of criminal proceeds. Non-compliance with RMI beneficial-ownership disclosure requirements attracts fines up to USD 10,000, deregistration of the Business Corporation, and reporting to regional FATF-style bodies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners engaged in AML evasion face personal criminal liability, asset forfeiture, travel bans, and imprisonment. Courts may pierce the corporate veil and order full personal restitution against foreign shareholder-principals where the company was used as a vehicle for money laundering or payment fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to report cross-border payments, omitting CRS/AEOI declarations on the annual registration, refusing to identify controlling persons, or ignoring an information request issued by the RMI competent authority on behalf of a treaty partner such as the United States, leading to international blacklisting exposure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Tax Information Exchange Agreement and Automatic Exchange of Information framework, penalties of USD 1,000 per omitted report and daily penalties of USD 100 per day of continued non-compliance apply. Repeated violations lead to revocation of the BC registration and referral to the OECD Global Forum for punitive listing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The RMI Registrar and Financial Intelligence Unit may impose fines directly on the registered agent and directors. Persistent non-cooperation triggers contempt proceedings, civil restitution, travel restrictions, seizure of RMI-located assets, and imprisonment of up to 12 months for responsible officers.
